title: Smoothed absolute value √(w²+η²) − η: C¹, gradient bound and η-closeness to |w|
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every C¹ function w : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) and every real η > 0, the function F(x) := √(w(x)² + η²) − η satisfies: (a) F is C¹; (b) ‖DF(x)‖ ≤ ‖Dw(x)‖ for every x, where D = Mathlib fderiv ℝ and ‖·‖ is the operator norm; (c) |F(x) − |w(x)|| ≤ η for every x.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : Rn n → ℝ) (η : ℝ), 0 < η → ContDiff ℝ 1 w → ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (w x ^ 2 + η ^ 2) - η) ∧ (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (w x ^ 2 + η ^ 2) - η) x‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖) ∧ ∀ x, abs (Real.sqrt (w x ^ 2 + η ^ 2) - η - |w x|) ≤ η
